mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers discount rates for equity valuation models, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as capital costs decrease.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% indicates accommodative policy during inflation, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 for the combined signal over any 3-year rolling window during 2005-2024.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rise in FEDFUNDS signals aggressive tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) directly increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k per month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1.2 million units (HOUST < 1200.0) signal residential sector contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in INDPRO and rise in GDPC1 growth signals supply chain disruption that increases production costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative 5-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 for the combined signal over any 3-year rolling window during 2005-2024.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals accelerating wage pressures that trigger Fed tightening, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE declines.
